source_note: Compiled from hearing notices, agendas, and scheduling orders on the docket, plus the Bidding Procedures Order (Docket #219) and Notice of Sale (Docket #251). Dates/times are as stated in those filings — always confirm a deadline against its linked source before relying on it.
how_to_attend_note: Per Judge Goldblatt's Chambers Procedures, hearings are held in person at the courthouse by default; status/scheduling conferences and first-day hearings are conducted remotely by default. There is no public standing Zoom link — anyone wanting to attend remotely must register in advance through the court's eCourtAppearances tool, due 4:00 p.m. ET the business day before (one hour before for first-day hearings). Attending in person requires no registration; the courtroom is open to the public.
recordings_note: This court does not post hearing recordings to YouTube or anywhere public-facing. Two things sometimes show up on the docket afterward: (1) an audio recording embedded inside a PDF, filed as “PDF File with Audio File Attachment” — the link opens a PDF wrapper; open it in a desktop PDF reader (e.g. Adobe Acrobat Reader) that supports embedded attachments to play it, most browser PDF viewers won't surface it. (2) An official certified transcript, orderable from the court reporter named on the matching “Request for Transcript” entry — these aren't available as a free download during an initial restriction window (shown below), only by purchase from the reporter.
